title: LAB Optimizations checklist

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: next/image is used with explicit sizes, priority on the LCP image, and a blur placeholder such that the listing page shows no visible layout shift (QA non-blocker: next/image usage does not introduce visible CLS — CLS < 0.1).

next/font self-hosts a font via the _lib/fonts.ts helper (no render-blocking external font request), and next/script demonstrates at least two loading strategies (e.g. afterInteractive and lazyOnload) with the choice explained.

<Link> prefetch behaviour is demonstrated and a prefetch request for a product detail route is observable as documented (QA non-blocker: prefetch behaviour is observable and matches documented expectation).
checklist.md documents per-route code-splitting verification (which chunk is client vs server) for this lab's route (QA non-blocker: code-splitting verification).

The lab _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
